With server auth on, the login screen hides Student Sign Up. A new password student cannot self-register; a parent creates the child, or the child uses a picture code. Demo login still works.
A parent-created P3 password student is sent to Build your Clew and cannot reach the Today hub without saving a character. The builder has no logout.
After password login the student is inside ClewQuest. The old Today hub opens from the Today button.

The parent link form asks for the child's password. A picture-code child has no password the parent knows, so a parent cannot link that child from the UI. Picture reset stays unreachable until a parent_child row already exists.
